description: Search the Morpho documentation (docs.morpho.org) by semantic similarity. Returns raw search hits; each hit carries the matched text plus metadata (page title, absolute docs.morpho.org url, breadcrumbs, excerpt).

rewriteQuery.description: Let the search service rewrite the query

scoreThreshold.description: Only return results scoring at or above this relevance score

topK.description: Maximum number of result chunks to return

name: morpho_doc_search
